Revenue from oil and natural gas sales is recognized at the point in time when control of the product transfers to the purchaser, generally upon delivery to the purchaser or designated delivery point, in accordance with the terms of the applicable sales agreements.
At that time, the Company's performance obligation is satisfied, and the Company has an enforceable right to payment.
